Hundreds of billions of dollars wiped off Nvidia. And now its boss of thirty-three years is gone.
On Thursday, Jensen Huang resigned, effective immediately, after a week of reports about his private life.
Finance chief Colette Kress now runs the chipmaker behind much of the world's AI. For now.
And for the first time ever, Nvidia has a board chair: Harvey Jones.
Shares fell more than four percent that day.
The real test: Tuesday's earnings. Can the AI giant run without its founder?
